title: HybridFlow: A 2-NFE Generative Policy for Real-Time Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2602.13718v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative policies for robotic manipulation must balance action accuracy with inference latency. We present HybridFlow, a three-stage policy inference procedure requiring two network function evaluations (2-NFE). A Global Jump uses the MeanFlow average velocity to generate a coarse action trajectory; a parameter-free ReNoise interpolation constructs a state at a nonzero refinement time; and a Local Refine queries the instantaneous-velocity limit of the same network at that time. This construction reuses a unified model without distillation. Our analysis characterizes interval-composition errors and the attenuation of endpoint error under ReNoise interpolation. Controlled RoboMimic ablations support the MeanFlow proposal and intermediate-state construction, achieving 95% average success with reused noise and 95.5% with fresh noise, versus 78% for one-step MeanFlow. translated_title: HybridFlow：一种用于实时机器人操作的2-NFE生成式策略
translated_abstract: 用于机器人操作的生成式策略必须在动作精度与推理延迟之间取得平衡。我们提出了HybridFlow，一种仅需两次网络函数评估（2-NFE）的三阶段策略推理流程。全局跳跃利用MeanFlow平均速度生成粗略的动作轨迹；无参数的ReNoise插值在非零的精细化时间点构造一个中间状态；局部精细化则在同一时间点查询同一网络的瞬时速度极限。这一构造复用了统一模型而无需蒸馏。我们的分析刻画了区间组合误差以及ReNoise插值下端点误差的衰减。在RoboMimic上的受控消融实验支持了MeanFlow提议与中间状态构造的有效性，在复用噪声的情况下达到95%的平均成功率，在新鲜噪声下达到95.5%，而单步MeanFlow仅为78%。在五个真实机器人设置中，所有策略运行在（原文截断）。
tldr: HybridFlow提出一种仅需两次网络函数评估（2-NFE）的三阶段生成式策略推理流程，通过MeanFlow全局跳跃、无参数ReNoise插值和局部精细化，在不蒸馏的情况下复用统一模型，实现实时机器人操作，成功率约95%且远超单步MeanFlow的78%。
en_tdlr: HybridFlow is a three-stage, 2-NFE generative policy that combines a MeanFlow global jump, parameter-free ReNoise interpolation, and local refinement to reuse a unified model without distillation, achieving real-time robotic manipulation with ~95% success rates versus 78% for one-step MeanFlow.
